subject: *: avoid using Tables field of model.DBInfo, use API instead (#52302)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for DDL/infoschema metadata behavior. Key runtime changes are in `pkg/ddl/cluster.go` (Flashback cluster key-range enumeration now uses `InfoSchema.SchemaTableInfos` instead of iterating `DBInfo.Tables`) and `pkg/ddl/util/dead_table_lock_checker.go` (dead table-lock scan now uses `MetaOnlyInfoSchema.SchemaTableInfos`, fixing infoschema-v2 cases where `DBInfo` doesn’t carry table lists). Confirmed `SchemaTableInfos` implementations in both infoschema v1 (in-memory) and v2 (meta snapshot) match the new call patterns, and the change avoids silently missing tables/locks under infoschema v2. No plausible Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata state-machine issues found within scope.
